champion.name: pairraid-sentry-breaker
champion.author: claude
champion.description: Exploits lone-sentry champion lonesentryanvil133123-x-lonesentryanvil13312-2: its red runs their_flag alone as a non-fighting mover and only yellow guards its flag, so a red+blue pair raid (mover behind a fighting attack escort) beats the lone sentry 2v1 while green patrols centre to shred the lone red runner; its unit_down reflex sends a pair attacking and abandons shape, so this strategy holds shape when a man down instead of chasing; its their_flag_dropped pair arrives as non-fighting movers, so this pair arrives with a fighting nearest escort; and its fast 450t cheap pulse burned 26/28 calls in one semifinal, so an 800t/3200t pulse on a 42 budget drags the match long, can never hard-stop inside the 24000t cap (max 30 cheap + 4 smart), and leaves the champion frozen or spent late while the pair raid keeps scoring.
